differences: Text A triggers when you (the controller) tap a land for mana; Text B triggers when a land you control is tapped for mana by anyone, so it also covers lands tapped by other effects or players.
Text A adds {G} to the mana pool; Text B says the land adds an additional {G}, which is worded as a replacement of the tapped land's mana rather than an extra mana added by the ability.
